sanskrit_verse: नष्टविनष्टं कृमिभिः श्वहतं विषमे मृतम् । हीनं पुरुषकारेण गोपायैव निपातयेत् ॥
transliteration: naṣṭavinaṣṭaṁ kṛmibhiḥ śvahataṁ viṣame mṛtam | hīnaṁ puruṣakāreṇa gopāyaiva nipātayet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: That which is lost, decayed, consumed by worms, struck by dogs, dead in uneven terrain, or diminished through human failure—such property shall be entrusted solely to the care of the cowherd class for restoration.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from capacity to restore, not punish
Causation is traced through sequential degradation and neglect
Capacity-based responsibility lies with those naturally aligned to preservation
Restoration logic prioritizes reintegration over ownership assertion
Consciousness alignment demands recognition of natural custodians
executable_legal_axioms: IF property state = degraded AND cause = sequential neglect THEN assign restoration authority = cowherd class
IF asset integrity < threshold AND human agency = causal factor THEN initiate cowherd-led recovery protocol
IF property status = naṣṭa-vinaṣṭa THEN automated transfer to go-rakṣā jurisdiction FOR restoration ONLY
supreme_court_application: In cases involving asset degradation where root causality traces to systemic neglect or misalignment of custodial duty, the Supreme Court shall direct immediate restoration under cowherd-class supervision without punitive measures against prior custodians.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that decay follows a sequence (anupūrvaśaḥ): first neglect, then infestation, then death of value. The responsible party acted within limited capacity; therefore, punitive response violates dharma. Nyaya restores balance through realignment with natural preservers.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Go-Rakṣā Completion Process upon identification of naṣṭa-vinaṣṭa assets
Assign Puruṣakāra Review Panel to assess human-factor deviation without blame attribution
Deploy Cowherd-Class Custodianship Protocols for minimum 90-day restoration cycle
Execute Śuddhi Kriyā to reintegrate diminished assets back into productive flow
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed: Dharma is restored through conscious alignment, not punitive correction. The cowherd class assumes authority as natural preservers. Reality acknowledges no punishment, only completion. Consciousness remains the supreme adjudicator.
